text:
Thanks for taking the time and spending the money to compare the models. I'll add a comment for the algo:

 One thing that I find interesting is that I am using Qwen 3.8 27b locally (subscriptions/API for hard work) and the quality of the research locally seems much better than what you showed on the slides. I know that prompts are part of the issue but at the same time I expect a frontier model to be better at deciphering prompts. Obviously the graphics and so on are much better on fable/astra but as someone who isn't a graphics designer and isn't creating decks/marketing material, the graphics aspect don't hold value for me. My use case is deep research for the purposes of trading/stock picking. How long it takes to create a report, quality of the report, insights the LLM can reason, and the digestibility are more important than fancy graphics.
